ev.q: From 1999 to 2011, motor vehicle traffic death rates declined by 49% for males aged 15–19 years
the highest rates occurred among males aged 20–24 years, followed by males aged 15–19 years
in 2010, the rate for females aged 20–24 years surpassed the rate for females aged 15–19 years
From 1999 to 2011, motor vehicle traffic death rates declined by 49%
Source: National Vital Statistics System. Mortality public use data files, 1999–2010.

methods_quotes.q: The populations used for computing death rates were enumerated as of April 1 for 2000 and 2010
